title: Non-function targets
summary: Call hierarchy preparation returns nothing for variables and enum constants
prose:
Preparing a call hierarchy on a variable or an enum constant returns
nothing; the request is offered only for functions and methods.

value.wrong: a call hierarchy should open on a variable, with the functions using it (clangd#1308)
a call hierarchy should open on an enumerator, with the functions using it (clangd#1308)
